headline: CHILE MONSTER STORM KNOCKS CODELCO AND ANTOFAGASTA OFFLINE — 1.6MT ANNUAL COPPER CAPACITY STALLED AS IRAN FLARE-UP ALREADY RATTLES METALS
snippet: A powerful winter storm swept Chile's key copper-producing regions on July 17, forcing Codelco to halt surface operations at its Andina mine and suspend ore shipments from El Teniente, Antofagasta Minerals to restrict access to Los Pelambres, and Anglo American to activate preventive protocols. The operations affected collectively represent approximately 1.6 million tonnes of temporarily suspended annual production capacity — roughly 2.5% of global mine supply. Copper futures fell below $6.2 per pound on the headline before stabilising near $6.34/lb on Comex, as the supply disruption added another dimension to a metals market already whipsawed by escalating US-Iran tension, which earlier drove oil above $84/bbl and reinforced bets on a September Fed rate hike. Three people were killed and hundreds displaced in flooding across central and southern Chile, with heaviest rains still expected over coming days.

headline: GOLDGROUP-GOLD RESOURCE $372M MEXICO MERGER CLOSES JULY 17 — MULTI-MINE PRECIOUS METALS PRODUCER TARGETS NYSE AMERICAN LISTING
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. and Gold Resource Corporation (NYSE American: GORO) confirmed the closing of their previously announced US$372 million business combination on July 17, 2026, following satisfaction of all closing conditions including approval by both companies' shareholders and sign-off from Mexico's National Antitrust Commission. The combined company — operating under the Goldgroup Mining name — now controls four mines across Mexico and the US: the Cerro Prieto mine and San Francisco project in Sonora, the Don David mine in Oaxaca, and the undeveloped Back Forty zinc-gold-silver project in Michigan. Goldgroup's anticipated NYSE American listing is expected to follow its previously announced 4:1 share consolidation, creating a multi-mine, cross-border precious metals producer targeting US-listed institutional capital.

headline: REVIVAL GOLD DRILLS 30.5m OF 1.65 g/t AT MERCUR UTAH — SHALLOW OXIDE GOLD EXPANDING AS 18,000m PROGRAM RAMPS TO FOUR RIGS (TSXV:RVG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Revival Gold Inc.
snippet: Revival Gold (TSXV: RVG) released first results from 13 reverse-circulation holes at its Mercur Gold Project in Utah — 7,400 metres completed in 74 holes of a planned 18,000-metre program — with headline intersections of 30.5 metres at 1.65 g/t Au (RM26-204, from 128m depth) and 30.5 metres at 0.92 g/t (RM26-183, from 145m). Additional holes returned 11 metres of 1.89 g/t Au from 50 metres and 6 metres of 2.44 g/t Au from 85 metres, with South Mercur emerging as a high-grade expansion zone beyond the PEA open pit. Two additional RC rigs are expected on site later this summer, growing the fleet to four. Approximately 8,500 metres of infill drilling is planned specifically to convert Inferred resources to Measured & Indicated in support of a Preliminary Feasibility Study targeted for Q1 2027. Mercur is targeting heap leach extraction on shallow oxide material.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS MAKES NEW DISCOVERY AT ANTINO NORTHEAST — 58.5m OF 1.00 g/t AU; 1,200m DRILL-CONFIRMED STRIKE, OPEN IN ALL DIRECTIONS (TSXV:FDR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Founders Metals Inc.
snippet: Founders Metals (TSXV: FDR) confirmed a new gold discovery at the Antino Northeast target within its fully funded 70,000-metre drill program in southeastern Suriname, with discovery hole ANE009 returning 58.5 metres at 1.00 g/t Au from 18.6 metres — including 18.0 metres at 1.59 g/t — and hole ANE002 returning 53.0 metres at 0.46 g/t from 149 metres approximately 1,200 metres away, establishing the first drill-confirmed strike length on a kilometre-scale gold-in-auger anomaly. Mineralization remains open in all directions and the majority of the auger anomaly has not yet been drill-tested. The company's July mid-year update also highlighted continued expansion at Antino North and Maria Geralda and a follow-up hole at Antino West, with Founders simultaneously advancing four separate gold systems in what is developing as a district-scale project in one of South America's most underexplored gold belts.

headline: NORTH ARROW DRILLS 9m OF 4.04 g/t AU AND EXPOSES NEW HANGING WALL GOLD AT KRAAIPAN — BOTSWANA BIF SYSTEM 40km FROM HARMONY'S KALGOLD (TSXV:NAR)
source_name: Investing News Network / North Arrow Minerals Inc.
snippet: North Arrow Minerals (TSXV: NAR) reported Rotation 2 reverse-circulation results from Targets AE and AF at the Kraaipan Gold Project in southern Botswana, with highlights of 27 metres at 1.11 g/t Au (including 12 metres at 1.71 g/t) at Target AE — which has 260 metres of drill-confirmed strike — and 9 metres at 4.04 g/t Au at Target AF across a 450-metre strike. Drilling also exposed an entirely new hanging wall gold-bearing zone in the host banded iron formation at Target AE, substantially expanding the system's structural complexity and resource potential. Kraaipan sits 40 kilometres north of Harmony Gold's multi-million-ounce Kalgold mine and represents the direct northern extension of the same Archean greenstone terrane, masked by shallow Kalahari sand cover that historically discouraged exploration. North Arrow's US$2.3 million 2026 program continues with Rotation 3 targeting new structural extensions.

headline: SPARTAN METALS EXPANDS TUNGSTONIA CLAIM 13-FOLD TO 5.7km² — 8 W-AG VEINS DEFINED, UP TO 5.18% WO3 AND 308 g/t AG; NEVADA DRILL STARTING AUG (TSXV:W)
source_name: Investing News Network / Spartan Metals Corp.
snippet: Spartan Metals (TSXV: W) released new rock chip and mapping results from the past-producing Tungstonia mine area at its Eagle Project in Nevada, expanding the mineralized footprint more than 13-fold since July 2025 to approximately 5.7 km² (2.7 km × 2.1 km), with eight confirmed tungsten-silver veins carrying a cumulative exposed surface strike length of 6.8 kilometres. Peak assay results returned 5.18% WO3 (tungsten trioxide) and 308 g/t silver, with Veins 3, 4, and 5 occurring as swarms of thinner sheets over 50–60 metre widths. Approximately 50% of the Tungstonia claims remain unexplored. The company plans ground geophysics followed by approximately 3,000 metres of diamond core drilling commencing in early to mid-August 2026. Tungsten is a US-designated critical mineral with no domestic primary production — essentially 100% of supply is sourced from China.

headline: ZODIAC GOLD LAUNCHES 5,000m DRILL ON LIBERIA'S 16km MONTERRA GOLD BELT — 37 OF 39 PRIOR HOLES HIT GOLD; UP TO 55.9 g/t AU (TSXV:ZAU)
source_name: Investing News Network / Zodiac Gold Inc.
snippet: Zodiac Gold (TSXV: ZAU) commenced a new diamond drilling program of up to 5,000 metres at its flagship Arthington discovery in Liberia on July 14, targeting resource growth along strike and at depth on the 16-kilometre Monterra Trend at the Todi Gold Project. The program builds on 37 of 39 prior holes returning significant gold intercepts — including high-grade hits up to 55.9 g/t Au — indicating strong mineralisation continuity across the trend. Drilling aims to increase density sufficiently to underpin a first NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate; Zodiac has also flagged the potential addition of a second rig in Q4 2026 to accelerate turnaround. West Africa's Birimian greenstone terrain hosting Arthington is one of the most productive gold districts on the planet, and Zodiac's tenure covers an underexplored portion the company believes is tracking toward a multi-million-ounce resource.

headline: HANNAN FILES DRILL PERMIT FOR PERU'S FIRST ALKALINE EPITHERMAL AU-CU — PREVISTO SAMPLES HIT 33.1 g/t AU; 7,650m PLAN AWAITS Q1-2027 APPROVAL (TSXV:HAN)
source_name: Investing News Network / Hannan Metals Ltd.
snippet: Hannan Metals (TSXV: HAN) submitted its Declaración de Impacto Ambiental (DIA) — the primary environmental certification required before drilling can proceed in Peru — for Previsto, the first documented alkaline epithermal gold-copper system in the country, at its 100%-owned Amanecer project. The approved drill plan covers 18 platforms and 7,650 metres of diamond drilling across Previsto Central and the Inca Garcilazo zone within a 2.3-hectare disturbance footprint over 361.4 hectares. Surface sampling has returned grades up to 33.1 g/t Au and 120 g/t Ag, with alkalic porphyry-epithermal features pointing to district-scale potential. Alkaline epithermal systems globally host some of the highest-grade and most valuable gold-copper deposits in the world; Previsto would be the first such system drilled in Peru. Final DIA approval is expected in Q1 2027.

headline: TOCVAN TARGETS Q4 2026 FIRST GOLD POUR IN MEXICO — GRAN PILAR 50,000-TONNE HEAP LEACH UNDER CONSTRUCTION; 10-YEAR PERMIT SECURED (CSE:TOC)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Tocvan Ventures Corp.
snippet: Tocvan Ventures (CSE: TOC) released a six-phase pilot mine plan for its Gran Pilar Gold-Silver Project in Sonora, Mexico, targeting a first gold-silver doré pour in Q4 2026 from a 50,000-tonne heap-leach facility already under construction. The company holds a 10-year pilot mine permit secured in August 2025 and a 6-year Community Agreement executed in May 2026. Heavy equipment was mobilized in April, site preparation is complete, and leach pad and containment pond construction is in progress. The facility design targets approximately 70% gold recovery over 60–90 day leach cycles, using a 1.76-hectare engineered pad with local crushing and a 5-column carbon-adsorption circuit. For a junior with CSE listing, reaching production-stage doré delivery is a significant de-risking milestone — the company's accountability as an operator, not just an explorer, is what distinguishes Gran Pilar from most junior development-stage projects.

headline: ED STEER: COMMERCIAL SHORT BOOK COMPRESSED AS PHYSICAL DEMAND TIGHTENS — GOLD AND SILVER PRIMED FOR SURGE, SIX DEFICIT YEARS CAN'T BE IGNORED
snippet: Ed Steer, in conversation with Money Metals Exchange's Mike Maharrey and cross-published on GoldSeek, argues that both gold and silver are positioned for the next major leg higher as the conditions underpinning 2026's sell-off — hawkish Fed fears, dollar strength, elevated bond yields — are more fragile than markets are pricing. Steer points to six consecutive structural supply deficits in silver, physical demand from Asia outpacing Western positioning, the commercial short book compressed to historically low levels at recent price lows, and government debt trajectories that make eventual currency debasement inevitable. He expects the metals to begin recovering in July or August and forecasts silver can return to triple-digit prices before year-end if commercial traders step aside — a squeeze scenario he sees as increasingly likely given the widening gap between paper positioning and physical availability. The call is explicit: this is the setup serious investors have been waiting for.
